status: Scoped durable site-permission acknowledgement and connection-management presentation accepted locally. Physical storage/crash, key/session persistence, device and release gates remain open.
behavior: Authorization loading awaits the real store read, propagates failures and can retry. Read-only list/tab-status callers settle without writing a projected account map back to storage.

Per-origin mutations serialize detached intents. Pending changes can only remove current authority; grants become active only after persistence acknowledges success. Failed grants are excluded from unrelated later writes and dependent same-origin writes reject until explicit retry.

Failed revocations stay vetoed in the running process and leave the base dirty. An identical deny/delete retry still writes; an explicit full replacement/reset always writes, including an unloaded empty map.

Popup approval awaits the grant write before resolving either popup or requesting dApp. A failed owned write keeps the request retryable, while cancellation, replacement or a competing origin mutation prevents late approval. Cancel during a pending grant immediately vetoes it and queues durable cleanup.

Account removal awaits a single permission mutation before deleting account/session/selection records. Authorization writes fail back to the caller, and WalletConnect storage read helpers propagate Chrome rejection instead of hanging.

Connection management catches read/save/remove failures. Failed removal keeps its displayed row; pending operations block duplicate actions. Save captures the displayed origin/type/accounts, and route/account/unmount epochs prevent old selections or late navigation from crossing contexts.

Only existing Substrate and EVM management routes are supported. EVM keeps one eligible selected identity. Full origin/account text, native labelled removal/details controls, explicit read retry, Calm route styling, shared focus tokens and selected keyboard-reachable wrapping protocol tabs are qualified.

findingsResolved.finding: An unloaded explicit empty reset could become a no-op and leave stored grants intact.
findingsResolved.resolution: Explicit replacement forces physical persistence, including an empty unloaded reset.

findingsResolved.finding: An identical denial/delete retry after a failed write could acknowledge without persisting the veto.
findingsResolved.resolution: Failed writes mark the base dirty; even an identical retry persists before acknowledgement.

independentReviews.disposition: No remaining scoped worker blocker found. Serial writes rebuild from the vetoed base, clear dirty only after acknowledgement, and reject same-origin dependants of failed writes. WalletConnect storage read wrappers propagate underlying rejection.
limits: Modeled process/store durability; no physical crash atomicity, relay/device or full key-storage qualification. UI callers reviewed separately.

independentReviews.disposition: No scoped async blocker found. Removal retains displayed row until awaited acknowledgement, blocks competing events and remains retryable. Details captures origin/type/addresses, synchronously invalidates route/account epochs and requires the rendered epoch, so old selections cannot submit and late acknowledgements cannot navigate after context changes or unmount. Read-error state and acknowledgement-only navigation are coherent.
limits: Reviewer inspected code and tests without rerunning web tests. Calm/focus/layout follow-ups and final browser inspection are root's separate verification.

presentationFollowupReview.disposition: No scoped blocker found. Active tab resolves actual child route name/type and matches the roving tabindex contract; same-tab selection avoids redundant navigation. Wrapped labels and inset focus retain native buttons, actual routes use existing Calm metadata, and AboveForm outer overflow keeps wrapped content reachable.
limits: Read-only code review; browser/palette/full-suite verification performed by root.

31 captures pass initial geometry. Raw compact review finds clipped protocol tabs and an outboard focus ring; final scoped wrapping and inset ring correct these, with explicit tab geometry assertions.
Each nested connection route leaves all protocol tabs unselected and tabindex=-1; actual route name/type mapping and redundant-navigation guard correct this.

limits: Store tests exercise the actual Authorize/Subscribable/BaseExtension/BaseWeb adapters with controlled Chrome runtime.lastError and IndexedDB transaction abort/completion. They do not force physical quota, power loss, OS crash or actual browser-worker eviction.

A failed revocation cannot erase durable data while storage is unavailable. It remains vetoed in this process and is reported as failed; restarting can reload the older physical grant until a later successful write. No stronger crash-atomic revocation guarantee is claimed.

The handler reset is qualified as an explicit full authorization-map replacement. Whole-wallet reset wiring, key/account/session import durability, multi-store atomicity and live WalletConnect relay restoration remain separate gates.

The final browser checks use isolated public display fixtures and headless software rendering, not actual permission writes or real signing. Unit tests establish worker storage failure behavior; browser captures establish popup behavior.

Existing Substrate/EVM management scope is preserved; no Solana/Iroha/TON management is enabled. Historical scope/key mapping, legacy origin migration, physical keyboard/touch/screen-reader, native-speaker locale and physical-device qualification remain open where separately required.

Eighteen inherited full-suite skips remain skips. Archives are test-only development builds; final historical upgrades/private-chain transactions, signed production artifacts and publication remain open.
